text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...What is it that I'm missing, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, no! I came here to take a break, 
so I need to forget about the long jump 
for now—
U-Urara-saaan... Take caaaare~~~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, here I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Uryaryaryaryaaaa... rya!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Skrrrrt!)

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Dotou
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan!? Urara-saaan!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, you two! But I'm totally fine! We 
can keep going with the 'Secret 
Boing-Boing Special Training'!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
H-Hop, hop...? Ah, are you doing long jump 
training, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Once I can jump really high, I'm 
gonna surprise everyone! Right, Doto-chan!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees! And so Urara-san kept working 
hard on her special training... but as for 
me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-Here goes...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyah— Ah, aahhh~! My shoelaces got tangled 
up...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Tying my shoelaces tight... Alright, this 
time for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Funyuu—W-Wait, come to think of it... 
Which leg am I supposed to jump from, left 
or right~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I keep messing up and still haven't 
cleared the bar! Uuu... I have to try 
harder...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(...Both of them are struggling to improve 
their long jump records...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, fell on my butt again! Still, 
jumping with everything you've got is 
super fun!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hau~... I failed again... Just a little 
bit more, though...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I might not set an impressive record, 
but... I just wanna do at least one proper 
jump...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Her spirit isn't broken at all. Time and 
time again, she keeps getting back up...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Whether I've hit my limit or 
not, it's not over yet—!”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um! May I join in on the "Secret 
Boing-Boing Special Training" too?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You too, Top Road-chan?! Of cooourse! 
Ehehe, this is gonna be even more fun 
now~♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... If you're really okay with 
someone like me, that is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I really want to be with the 
two of you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because— you taught me something truly 
important!
